culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Keigo Hiura. Amongst many of the deliveries which he has ordered to his room, Minazuki came to the suite disguised as room service who delivered red wine. As it is usual for red wine to be decanted before serving, it wouldn't be too unusual to lead the service person into one's kitchen. The publisher mentioned that even though he saw the female bellhop arrive at the suite, since they were too focused on eating as much food as possible, they couldn't have noticed her leaving or staying in the suite.

motive.zhHans: 出版社的人提到，虽然他看见了那个女侍应生来到套房，但因为他们当时太专注于尽可能多吃些东西，所以不可能注意到她是离开了还是留在了套房里。他让她在那里等他，并脱掉酒店侍应生制服，因为要给尸体脱衣服并不容易。下午4点30分他出门去买香烟，却去了受害者的房间，把她放到门前，好让送香槟的男侍应生看到她。他从自己房间里拿走了洗发水的瓶盖，因为受害者之前用过它们，而他想把它们换掉，但他没来得及换，身上还一直带着它们。Keigo承认了罪行，说关于她是“吃男人”的传闻是假的，相反，多次拒绝他的人是她，因为他已经结婚了。Keigo说这是一个幼稚的暗号，柯南回答说这并不让他意外，因为这是小孩子想出来的。她之所以保密，是想给他一个惊喜，并希望一旦暗号被解开，他能猜出她的身份。
motive.en: The publisher mentioned that even though he saw the female bellhop arrive at the suite, since they were too focused on eating as much food as possible, they couldn't have noticed her leaving or staying in the suite. He asked her to wait there for him and take off the hotel page uniform, since it wouldn't be easy to undress a corpse. At 4.30 PM he left in order to buy cigarettes, but went to the victim's room to place her in front of the door for the bellboy to see her once he delivered the champagne. He has removed the shampoo bottle caps from his room since the victim had used them earlier and he wanted to replace them, which he didn't do in time, and he still carried them on him. Keigo admits to the crime, saying that the "man eating" rumors about her were false, instead, she was the one who declined him many times since he was married. Keigo says that it is a childish code, to which Conan replies that it doesn't surprise him since it was thought up by a child. The reason she kept it a secret was because she wanted to surprise him and hoped that he would figure out her identity, once the code was reveal.

method.zhHans: 在他让人送到自己房间的众多送餐服务之中，Minazuki乔装成送红酒的客房服务人员来到了套房。世良解释说，当出版社的人在主房间吃饭时，Keigo在浴室里勒死了受害者。他杀掉她之后把她放进了大行李箱里，利用绳子和一种特殊的结，经过一些练习后，他轻易地在客人们离开后把她放到了下层阳台上。他从自己房间里拿走了洗发水的瓶盖，因为受害者之前用过它们，而他想把它们换掉，但他没来得及换，身上还一直带着它们。当“'Denwa, umi watashi'”（でんわ, うみ わたし ?, “电话，海和我”）从日语翻译成英语并调换词序后，它可以被读作“I, sea tel”，用罗马字发音连在一起可以读作“Aishiteru”，意思是“我爱你”。
method.en: Amongst many of the deliveries which he has ordered to his room, Minazuki came to the suite disguised as room service who delivered red wine. Masumi explains that while the publishers were eating in the main room, Keigo has strangled the victim in the bath. He had put her in the big suitcase after murdering her, and by using a rope and a special knot he easily, after some practice, was able to lower her on the lower balcony after the guests have left. He has removed the shampoo bottle caps from his room since the victim had used them earlier and he wanted to replace them, which he didn't do in time, and he still carried them on him. When "'Denwa, umi watashi'" (でんわ, うみ わたし ?, "cellphone, sea and I") is translated from Japanese to English and the word order is switched, it can be read as "I, sea tel" which with Romaji pronunciation can be combined and read as "Aishiteru" meaning "I love you".

evidence.zhHans: 作为决定性证据，世良提到了他们在另一层楼的垃圾桶里找到的侍应生制服，它可以很容易地用来检测犯人和受害者的DNA及汗液。
evidence.en: As conclusive evidence Sera mentions the page uniform which they found on another floor in the trash, which could easily be tested for the culprit's and victim's DNA and sweat.
